bug_semantics: Stored XSS in tag-icon rendering: a user-supplied tag.icon is interpolated into an HTML string by mapIcon() as `` and that string is bound with Vue v-html. A crafted icon can break out of the intended class attribute and execute markup when the tag is shown, including on the administrative triage UI. The fix stops HTML construction, binds a constrained FontAwesome class via :class, and rejects unknown icons on store.
flaw_origin: First write of mapIcon() returning an HTML string and of v-html="mapIcon(tag.icon)" in 78c528c22a83fbfa01a87a708b78abea5199aebb (chg: [tag] new way to manage tag), which added website/web/static/js/tags/utils/galaxie.js and website/web/static/js/tags/singleTagDisplay.js. e00678357702213743724267333f8372c4fc3dc1 added the tag admin surface without this HTML-interpolation sink. e53289696578e7f6ea647b85175d7d6d8f13bf61 later reused the same mapIcon/v-html pattern in multiTagFilter.js and is not the BIC.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. git cat-file -p 78c528c22a83fbfa01a87a708b78abea5199aebb shows author/committer ecrou-exact <geffetheo@gmail.com> and message `chg: [tag] new way to manage tag` with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI, or bot trailer.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-3vx2-8r8r-pf7r / CVE-2026-73159 is published (CVE.org state PUBLISHED, GHSA withdrawn_at null) and cites cc13416d606d91d543ce1f1e41387750f8450153. git log -S mapIcon --follow on website/web/static/js/tags/utils/galaxie.js and git log --diff-filter=A --follow on that path both isolate 78c528c22a83fbfa01a87a708b78abea5199aebb. git grep on that commit shows export function mapIcon returning `` and singleTagDisplay.js v-html="mapIcon(tag.icon)" (template and tooltip). git cat-file -e 78c528c22a83fbfa01a87a708b78abea5199aebb^ succeeds, but cat-file -e PARENT:website/web/static/js/tags/utils/galaxie.js and PARENT:website/web/static/js/tags/singleTagDisplay.js both fail, and git grep for mapIcon|v-html="mapIcon|fas fa-${ on parent b608b50a41c4eb2e73738f6a29a297d67c0d2ebf under website/web/static/js, templates, and tags is empty. git cat-file -p 78c528c22a83fbfa01a87a708b78abea5199aebb is a single-parent commit with human author only. e00678357702213743724267333f8372c4fc3dc1 adds tags.py/admin_tags.html without mapIcon HTML interpolation. e53289696578e7f6ea647b85175d7d6d8f13bf61 adds multiTagFilter.js copies of the same v-html sink after the BIC. Fix cc13416 replaces v-html with :class, changes mapIcon to a slug-checked class string, and adds _icon_is_valid() on create/edit.
reasoning: The vulnerability is real stored XSS in tag-icon rendering, not a withdrawn advisory. The smallest public commit that first wrote mapIcon HTML construction and v-html consumption is 78c528c22a83fbfa01a87a708b78abea5199aebb; the earlier tag-admin commit lacks this sink, and the later multiTagFilter commit only spreads it. That BIC commit object has a human author/committer and no AI marker, so authorship is NOT_AI. cc13416d606d91d543ce1f1e41387750f8450153 is both the direct and closing fix named by the advisory.
